payload.claim: The strings output shows a function called checkSerial. Try disasm(checkSerial) to read its assembly code — the validation logic is likely there, not in main.
Look at the cmp and strlen calls in the disassembly — the binary checks the input length against a specific value before doing any other validation.
The loop in checkSerial increments by 2 and compares adjacent characters using sub and cmp. This means the validation depends on the relationship between character pairs, not individual characters.
